description: The person's portfolio, private to them: one score across every site they have claimed, half for what was improved while they held each site, three tenths for where the sites stand now, and a fifth for search traffic, not counted yet. Every site by its real name with what it gives each part and why, what the public would see of it, and for each part what would move it most. A score says the pages are well formed; it does not say an assistant cites them, or who made the changes.
name: mttr_portfolio
title: Get the portfolio
